svg.title: Hexagonal configurations in Aperiodic Life
svg.desc: Six configurations, each shown at four exact generations. Each row retains the same view and scale so expansion, rotation and emitted patterns can be compared. Blue cells are live; gold cells are refractory.

g.text: Exact simulation phases on the six-neighbour grid. One common view and scale within each row.
A compact seed expands and contracts through an exact 57-generation cycle.
Each 62-generation interval rotates the complete configuration by 60 degrees.
A maximum-size phase, the halfway configuration and the exact return at generation 248.
Three 333-generation intervals complete one full rotational cycle.
Successive emissions: the complete expanding field is not a stationary oscillator.
By generation 8, seven separated copies of the original three-cell seed are present.
Generated from the catalogue, production automaton and exact tile polygons. All active cells fit inside every panel.
